tools.name: calculate_break_even_roas
tools.description: Calculate break-even and target-profit ROAS and maximum CPA from user-supplied revenue, costs, percentage fees and refund reserve. Ask for missing inputs even if asked not to ask questions. Unknown fields must be null, never guessed zeros or a default currency. If any input is unknown, returns needs

tools.name: compare_profit_scenarios
tools.description: Compare two to five user-supplied pricing or cost scenarios in one currency. Unknown inputs must be null, never guessed zeros or a default currency. If any scenario is incomplete, returns needs_input with labeled questions and no numeric comparison; ask for those inputs. Complete scenarios return co

tools.name: build_campaign_utm
tools.description: Format one HTTP(S) campaign URL with source, medium and campaign, plus optional content and term. Trims and lowercases UTM values and replaces whitespace with underscores. Returns naming warnings. Never visits the URL, sends a message, saves a campaign or changes tracking settings.

tools.name: search_ecommerce_resources
tools.description: Search Ecomwith published tutorial metadata, internal tool descriptions and public answer summaries in English or Chinese. Returns up to ten source links with content access labels. Does not search the wider web, fetch websites or return paid lesson bodies, drafts or customer data.

tools.name: list_public_weekly_reports
tools.description: List up to ten Ecomwith published or corrected ecommerce reports with public summaries and dates. Does not return drafts, withdrawn issues, member-only sections, subscriber data or unpublished research. These are dated editorial reports, not a live news feed.

tools.name: get_public_weekly_report
tools.description: Read guest excerpts and cited source links for one published or corrected Ecomwith weekly report, using a slug returned by list_public_weekly_reports. Retain publication and correction dates and each cited source verificationStatus label; do not upgrade weaker evidence. Rechecks publication state ea
